Move SessionData.toMatrixUser() extension to a common place, then use it across the codebase.

Let the user switch account from the room select screen when sharing

When several accounts are signed in, sharing into the app no longer goes through the account selection screen. The room select screen (Share mode) now displays the selected account and an account switch on top of the room list, with a design similar to the multi account section of the settings.

Selecting another account displays the rooms of this account in place, scrolled to the top, without recreating the screen. The content is then shared from the room select screen using the selected account, with the same progress and error dialogs as when sharing with the current account. The current account is switched only once the share has succeeded, then the room is opened if the content has been shared to a single room.

Implementation:
- RoomSelectNode is now in the AppScope and uses MatrixClientProvider to get the room list of the selected session.
- ShareNode gets the SharePresenter of the selected session from its session graph, using the new ShareBindings.
- SessionGraphFactory is moved to the matrix api module so that it can be used by features.

The account selection screen is still used for permalinks.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Update screenshots
Fix flaky test.

Introduce ShareDataSender so that SharePresenter is not session scoped

Instead of creating a SharePresenter from the graph of another session, the
SharePresenter now gets the client of the selected session from the
MatrixClientProvider and uses an AppScope ShareDataSender to send the data.

To be able to send media from AppScope, MediaSenderRoomFactory is now bound in
AppScope and takes the MatrixClient as a parameter, and a new
MediaOptimizationConfigProviderFactory provides the media optimization config
of any session.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Move SessionGraphFactory back to the appnav module

The share feature does not need it anymore, so there is no reason to expose it
in the matrix api module.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Ref: https://www.figma.com/design/kEAcfun9iSpszeUDvdKZ6b/ER-351--Multi-account-in-EX?node-id=195-40292

Render an error in the room select screen if the rooms cannot be loaded

If the client of the selected account cannot be restored, the room list was
never loaded and there was no feedback to the user.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Display an error in the room select screen if the selected account has an invalid token

All the accounts are proposed in the account switch, even the ones with an
invalid token, so that the user can still see them. If the selected account
has an invalid token, or is invalidated while the screen is displayed (for
instance signed out from another device), the error is displayed instead of
the room list, the selected rooms are cleared, and the client of this account
is not used anymore.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Update screenshots

Get the media optimization config only once when sharing media

The config is the same for all the files and all the rooms, so there is no need to read it for each file.
